137959.overview:
It's been 65 million years! Amiga CDTV/CD32 multimedia CD-ROM on the topic of dinosaurs shows you in a fun but educational way what life may have been like in the time of the giants. 

Insight DINOSAURS is the second in the 'INSIGHT series for CD32, CDTV and A570 owners. Produced in association with The Natural History Museum, London and featuring the work of world renowned Dinosaur illustrators. Lavishly produced with photos, illustrations, computer graphics, motion video, text, narration and sound effects, this unique title brings to life these long dead giants of the past. Dinosaur A-Z, Death of the Dinosaur, Anatomy, Attack & Defense, Carnivores, Herbivores, Shifting Continents, Climate, Fossil Hunters, Fossil Hunting, Timeline, Family Tree and Funosaurus which includes quiz, Chinese puzzler and paint book. Fun and facts for ALL the family! Royalties in aid of The Natural History Museum's research into improving the environment

137960.overview:
Amiga CDTV/CD32 multimedia CD that explains how things work. Have you ever wondered how things actually worked? From the simple ball-point pen to the mighty space shuttle - Insight: Technology for the AMIGA CD32 will answer your questions. Explore over 300 full-color computer graphic images, ranging from static, exploded diagrams to action-packed animations. In addition, you can browse through an extensive photo library containing over 700 photographs produced as eye-catching and entertaining narrated slideshows. Read about each topic in-depth and see topics spring to life with motion video clips.

Insight: Technology has been designed in an easy pick up and read style to be exciting, informative and educational for your family. Why fill a shelf when you can fill your mind?

137974.overview:
It is 1938 and adventurer Indiana Jones is joined by his father on this quest, preventing Adolf Hitler from capturing the Holy Grail. He will have to deal with Nazi guards, the Luftwaffe and enemy spies as he tries to stop the tyrannical Nazi leader.

The Graphic Adventure uses the same SCUMM gameplay system as the previous Maniac Mansion. Most of the screen is used for a visual rendition of the current scene. At the bottom of the screen are words, which can be clicked on using the mouse to activate their functions. For example, objects can be picked up, used, pushed or pulled, and turned on and off. Most locations are from the movie, but some further scenes are added.

140427.overview:
Indiana Jones follows an ancient medallion around the world to discover the secret of Atlantis before the Nazis can wield its terrible power in this classic LucasArts point-and-click adventure.

It was never officially released on the Commodore CDTV.

462603.overview: It Came from the Desert is an action-adventure game that derives its inspiration from the many cult-horror B-Movies of the 50's and 60's, the 1954 film Them in particular. The player plays the part of Dr. Greg Bradley, a geologist and the newest resident in town. Eager to satisfy his scientific mind, Bradley sets out to examine the crash-site of a mysterious meteor, but what he finds is not at all what he had been looking for.
